description: This file defines a Kotlin class 'LocalStore' responsible for managing lightweight app state persistence using SharedPreferences. It handles reading and writing data such as shopping cart contents, recent searches, and catalog filter states within an Android app.

classes.name: LocalStore
classes.description: A class to manage local key-value persistence for app state, including cart, recent searches, and catalog filters.

methods.name: readCart
methods.description: Reads the cart map from SharedPreferences, parsing a custom string format into a Map of product IDs to quantities.

methods.name: writeCart
methods.description: Persists the cart Map into SharedPreferences using a custom string format.

methods.name: readRecentSearches
methods.description: Reads a list of recent searches from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: writeRecentSearches
methods.description: Stores a list of recent search strings into SharedPreferences.

methods.name: readCatalogSelectedCategoryId
methods.description: Retrieves the selected catalog category ID, if present.

methods.name: writeCatalogSelectedCategoryId
methods.description: Stores the selected catalog category ID or null.
